system.description: Toggle between being mounted on your horse or being unmounted.
Protected from Missile, Fire and Shadow damage. Vulnerable to Holy damage.

This extremely sharp blade has a penchant for striking vital points.

Inflicts 1 stack of Bleeding on hit. 3 stacks on a critical hit.
This deadly spear has a penchant for striking vital points.

Conjure a cloud of noxious magic, rapidly rotting everything within it. Designate a point within Rng of the spell. All units within a 1 tile square radius of that point suffer 2d8 Decay damage and 1 Brk. Affected units must also succeed a Mgt Saving Throw (DC = 10 + caster Wit) or else suffer the Corpse Rot condition for 3 turns. Corpse Rot deals another 2d8 Decay damage and 1 Brk each turn. Units with Corpse Rot are considered Undead, lose any protection against Slashing, Piercing, Crushing and Missile damage, and cannot be healed.

Summon an Imp or a Wight to serve you in battle. The summoned creature can act immediately.

 - Imp: An Undead/Flying unit that can cast Firebolts. Frail in constitution, but provides reliable magical damage. 
 - Wight: An Undead infantry unit. Serves as a useful melee fighter. You can choose whether this unit spawns with a slashing, piercing or crushing weapon.

Conjure a horrifying illusion that clouds its victims in terror. On a failed Cha saving throw (DC = 6 + Caster Cha), affected targets suffer -4 Tqn and must flee away from the caster as far as they are able on their next turn, taking no other action.

 Uses: 1 per Occult rank

An unstable orb of magic. Who knows what it'll do...

Inflicts a randomized damage type between Fire, Ice, Lightning, Wind, Arcane, Decay and Shadow.
While mounted, allows you to move again after taking an action, up to your remaining movement.

Each square you move prior to attacking increases the Atk of your first attack in a fight by 1. This applies only if you are attacking with a Blade, Polearm or Heavy weapon. For example, if you move 7 squares prior to an attack, your first attack will gain +7 Atk. Subsequent attacks, if you have any, will not benefit from this bonus.

Only takes effect while Mounted.
Effective damage against this unit is greatly diminished (1.35x Atk multiplier instead of 2x)

effects.name: Mounted: Nightmare
effects.description:
Mount Bonuses: +2 Mov, +10 HP, +1 Stn, +1 Eva, +2 Atk, +1 Spd, +2 Acc

Unit Types: Cavalry, Undead
